summary: Updates RFC 3279 to specify algorithm identifiers and ASN.1 encoding for DSA and ECDSA signatures that use SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, or SHA-512. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Certificates need to name the signing method they use. This document adds names for signing methods that use stronger fingerprint math.
